## Positioning

Anas Tanveer builds web systems that solve real business problems rather than
delivering generic templates. His process starts by mapping the actual business
workflow, then engineering Laravel modules, role-based dashboards, APIs, queues,
reporting and a clean database structure around it. The result is maintainable
software that reduces manual work, improves operational control, and scales.

## Services (detailed)

1. Custom Laravel Web Application Development
   For businesses outgrowing spreadsheets, plugin workarounds, or websites that
   cannot handle real operations. Delivers secure workflows, admin control,
   role-based dashboards, APIs, queues, reports and clean database design.
   Stack: Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Livewire, React, REST APIs.

2. Scalable Business Dashboard & Admin Panel Development
   Custom dashboards and admin panels for operations, analytics and team control.

3. WordPress Business Website Development (SEO Optimized)
   Fast, secure, search-optimized WordPress sites for businesses.

4. Shopify Advanced Customization & Conversion Optimization
   Custom Shopify theme work, size mapping, checkout and conversion improvements.

5. ERP & CRM System Development
   Tailored ERP/CRM systems aligned to real business processes.

6. SaaS Platform Development (Laravel / React based)
   Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, billing, roles and scalable backends.

7. Custom API Development & Third-Party Integrations
   REST API design and integration with payment, logistics and external systems.

8. Website Speed Optimization & Core Web Vitals
   Performance tuning for LCP, CLS and INP — faster, better-ranking sites.

9. SEO-Friendly Website Development
   Technical SEO foundations, structured data and crawlable architecture.

10. Trading Platforms & Financial Dashboards
    Calculators, prop-firm tools and finance analytics systems.

11. Location-Based Web Applications
    Maps, geo features and location tracking systems.

12. UI/UX Redesign & Conversion Optimization
    Redesigns focused on clarity, trust and conversion.
